name: Whack-a-Mole
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A screen-free arcade game: ten LED Buttons are mole holes, and one lights up at random for you to whack before it disappears. A Knob sets the difficulty and starts the round, and a Buzzer keeps score with beeps and tunes. The moles get faster the better you do. No app screen needed once it's running.
assembly_guide: Connect all 10 LED Buttons, the Buzzer and the Knob to the PicoHub I2C ports (use Qwiic branches / a hub to fan out — they all share one I2C bus).
The game lights only one LED at a time, so it runs on standard USB power — no PowerHub needed.
Run setup in the noknok app — no role assignment needed; every button is a mole hole.
Turn the Knob to pick a difficulty, then press it to start.
